onboard.title: Onboard an agency
onboard.intro: This creates the agency's organization, its business profile and its subscription, and emails its Owner an invite to choose a password.

agency.heading: The agency
agency.name: Agency name
agency.codeHint: 3 to 12 letters or digits, like SHARMA. Staff without email sign in with it, and it never changes.
agency.contactEmailHint: Replies to the agency's emails go here.

profile.heading: Business profile
profile.gstinHint: Optional. Its first two digits are its state's code.

owner.heading: Owner
owner.name: Owner's name
owner.emailHint: The invite goes here. Its link to choose a password lasts 72 hours.

subscription.heading: Subscription

starts.trial: A trial of the usual length
starts.trial-until: A trial until a day you choose
starts.paid: Active, already paid through a day

subscription.trialLength: {count, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}, today the first
subscription.noPlans: No plan is on sale. A super admin adds plans on the Plans screen.

problems.codeInvalid: Use 3 to 12 letters or digits, like SHARMA.
problems.emailInvalid: Type a real email address, like name@example.com.
problems.nameInvalid: Use a visible name of at most 120 characters.
problems.gstinInvalid: Check the GSTIN: 15 characters, ending in a check character that must match.
problems.gstinOtherState: This GSTIN is of another state. Its first two digits are its state's code.

organization.title: Organization
organization.notFound: There is no such organization. It may have been deleted for good.
organization.onboarded: The Owner has an email invite to choose a password. Its link lasts 72 hours.

record.heading: Organization
record.name: Name
record.dialogDescription: Its name, time zone and contact email. Its code never changes: staff usernames contain it.
record.contactEmailHint: Optional. Replies to the agency's emails go here.

problems.emailInvalid: Type a real email address, like name@example.com.

profile.heading: Business profile
profile.hint: The Owner keeps it up to date from the agency's settings; the account number shows its last four digits only.

members.heading: Members
members.inviteSent: A new invite is on its way to {email}.

impersonate.title: Sign in as {name}?
impersonate.description: You'll see {organization} as {name} does, and what you change is theirs. It is recorded in the organization's audit log and ends after an hour at most. Stop from the banner at the top.
impersonate.notAMember: {name} is no longer active staff, so you can't sign in as them.
